notes.title: Dandelion Updates
notes.content:
Hi Dandelion users!

We have 6 important updates:

1. ***If you have bought the games through Steam, you can ignore this.
We decided to discontinue support for the Cheritz download client starting from June 30, 2015.
This is to provide more stable services and updates. If you haven't already please request
a Steam key to play the game on Steam. We now sell Steam keys from our website for a cheaper price. 


2. Major Dandelion UI updates and we added a complimentary Drama CD in the game with translations.
This update is only available for the Steam version of the game. 
(To access the Drama CD you need to clear all routes)

3. Added Free Talk and Christmas Card translations.

4. Added Steam Cloud saves. So now you can play the game on multiple computers
and have the same save files!

5. Added Steam User Authentication to the game to prevent people from abusing the game.
So to launch the game you need to be logged into Steam. We now collect IP addresses and your Steam
ID when playing the game.

6. You need a steady internet connection now through the game to play it.

For more information please visit https://shop.cheritz.com/en/steam/info
